The issue was that the original pods were created before the ConfigMap was updated to "beta", so they cached the old "alpha" value from when the ConfigMap had that content. By deleting the pods, they were recreated fresh from the Deployment template, which references the same ConfigMap by name. When the new containers started, they read the current ConfigMap value ("beta").

The fix was: Delete all app Pods to trigger recreation, allowing them to pick up the updated ConfigMap value.
